name: zumer
description: Agent skills for the Zumerlab libraries: Orbit, Zumly, Pulse and SnapDOM.

plugins.name: orbit
plugins.description: Radial interfaces with Orbit 2: gauges, dials, knobs, radial menus, donut charts, progress rings.

plugins.name: zumly

plugins.name: pulse

plugins.name: snapdom
plugins.description: Capture DOM elements in the browser with SnapDOM 3: PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, canvas or Blob, and PDF, vector, GIF and video through plugins.
